title: 第294章 提车第293章 都在修炼
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：乡村大炮第一卷：默认第294章提车（..la）翌日。
李大炮再次去看了一眼药材，所有药材的长势都非常喜人，而且药性十足，比野生的药材更胜一筹。
“种这些普通的药材也有些浪费，应该种植人参，灵芝这些药材。”
李大炮心中暗道，虽然种植这些药材需要花费几十年，上百年的时间，他自己可能用不上，但是却可以留给子孙后代。
“今天多搞一些人参灵芝的种子，拿出一个保温棚，专门种植这些药材。”
李大炮做好了决定，他刚准备出发，后面孟晚晴追了出来。
“大炮，天气冷了，穿件厚的外套。”
孟晚晴说道，大家都把羽绒服翻出来了，就他还穿着一件单薄的外套。
李大炮可是一个修仙者，根本感觉不到冷，不过确实也不能表现的太过异类，因此穿上了外套。
“走吧，我们一起去大黑驴镇。”李大炮说道。
孟晚晴立即上了他的车，今天去镇里咨询一下，看看盖新房子都需要哪些手续。
他们到了镇里就分道扬镳，李大炮先去找了徐云云，把盖房子的事情先敲定下来。
“云云，我们村已经决定了，所有人都要盖新房，你安排人去我们村里做实地考察，然后做一个规划画图出来。”
李大炮说道，必须得打造出一个新农村，让所有人住的舒坦。
“大炮，你自己出钱？还是村里的人出钱？”
徐云云问道，她搓着自己的手，似乎冻得手有些冷。
李大炮立即抓住她的手，把自己的温暖传递给她，随后说道：“村民们出一部分，我出一部分。”
实际上都是他出的，因为他又给村民们涨了工钱，涨出来的工钱用来盖房子，相当于就是他出的钱。
徐云云立即感觉不冷了，不仅手暖和，整颗心都非常暖和。
“大炮？怎么回事？你身上怎么这么暖和？”

徐云云非常惊讶，感觉他就是冬天里的火炉子，很想钻进他的怀里取暖。
“身体好的男人，就是冬暖夏凉。”李大炮笑道。
“那你这身体好的有点过分了。”
徐云云主动钻进他的怀里，似乎舍不得离开了。
这个时候车行刘经理打电话过来了，告诉他订购的迈巴赫已经送到了4S店，等着他过去提车。
“云云，你现在有没有时间？”李大炮问道。
“你，你要干嘛？”
徐云云立即紧张起来，还以为李大炮这个时间想干坏事。
“带你去玩。”
李大炮说道，随后带着她出发，没有骑三轮车，打了个车过去。
“李总，您可算来了，您的车已经全部整备完毕，随时可以提走。”刘经理伸出双手，恭敬地握了握。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Country Cannon Volume 1: Default Chapter 294 Picking up the car (..la) the next day.
Li Dapao took a look at the medicinal materials again. The growth of all the medicinal materials was very gratifying, and they were full of medicinal properties, which were better than wild medicinal materials.
"It's a bit wasteful to grow these common medicinal materials. We should plant ginseng, Ganoderma lucidum and other medicinal materials."
Li Dapao secretly thought that although it would take decades or hundreds of years to grow these medicinal materials, he might not be able to use them himself, but he could leave them to future generations.
"Today we will buy more ginseng and Ganoderma lucidum seeds and set up a heat preservation shed to grow these medicinal materials."
Li Dapao made his decision and was just about to set off when Meng Wanqing chased him out.
"Cannon, it's cold. Wear a thick coat."
Meng Wanqing said, everyone had turned out their down jackets, but he was the only one still wearing a thin coat.
Li Dapao was an immortal cultivator and couldn't feel the cold at all, but he couldn't act too strange, so he put on a coat.
"Let's go to Dahei Donkey Town together." Li Dapao said.
Meng Wanqing immediately got in his car and went to the town to consult today to see what procedures were required to build a new house.
They parted ways when they arrived in the town. Li Dapao went to Xu Yunyun first to finalize the matter of building a house.
"So, our village has decided that everyone will build new houses. You arrange for people to go to our village to conduct on-site inspections, and then make a plan and draw it."
Li Dapao said that a new countryside must be built so that everyone can live comfortably.
"Cannon, do you pay for it yourself? Or do people in the village pay for it?"
Xu Yunyun asked. She rubbed her hands, which seemed to be a little cold from the cold.
Li Dapao immediately grabbed her hand, passed on his warmth to her, and then said: "The villagers will contribute part, and I will contribute part."
In fact, it was all paid for by him, because he gave the villagers a wage increase, and the increased wages were used to build houses, which was equivalent to his money.
Xu Yunyun immediately felt less cold. Not only his hands were warm, but his whole heart was also very warm.
"Cannon? What's going on? Why are you so warm?"
Xu Yunyun was very surprised. He felt like a stove in winter and wanted to get into his arms to keep warm.
"A man in good health is warm in winter and cool in summer." Li Dapao said with a smile.
"Then your good health is a bit too much."
Xu Yunyun took the initiative to get into his arms and seemed reluctant to leave.
At this time, manager Liu of the car dealership called and told him that the Maybach he ordered had been delivered to the 4S store and was waiting for him to pick up the car.
"Yunyun, do you have time now?" Li Dapao asked.
"You, what do you want to do?"
Xu Yunyun immediately became nervous, thinking that Li Dapao wanted to do something bad at this time.
"Take you to play."
Li Dapao said, and then he took her off and took a taxi instead of riding a tricycle.
"Mr. Li, you're here. Your car is all ready and can be picked up at any time." Manager Liu stretched out his hands and shook them respectfully.
